info.title: Harness voice activity additions (design)
info.description: Existing hosted API is retained. This contract adds advisory voice activity and expiring warning metadata; it does not grant game-state mutation.

202.description: Latest activity accepted or older sequence ignored; no game state mutation

429.description: Rate limited; coalesce updates, do not queue retries

inputStopped.description: Microphone tracks have been stopped for final playback. Required to infer final silence; omitted by older clients.

CommandBatchAdditions.description: Add serverNow and the current PublicGameState as state to POST /api/play/commands/poll. Terminal state stops the microphone before final commentary is sent. Existing command fields and sequence/ack semantics remain. Expired warnings are skipped but acknowledged by the browser.

WarningCommandAdditions.description: Optional metadata on existing CoreLiveCommand for warnings only; remove metadata before sending to OpenAI. validUntil is server epoch milliseconds. Non-warning commands keep their existing retention.
